name: Livestorm
description_en:
Livestorm is a browser-based event/webinar platform covering registration, reminders, live interaction, replay and marketing-system handoffs. A registrant, an actual attendee and a team moderator are different records with different billing implications.

Its current pricing centers on attendee credits used across sessions over twelve months. Do not substitute an older host-seat or monthly-active-contact model for the dated offer read here.
description_zh:
Livestorm 是浏览器活动/网络研讨会平台，覆盖注册、提醒、直播互动、回放及营销系统交接。注册者、实际参加者及团队主持人是不同记录，计费含义不同。

当前定价围绕十二个月内跨场次使用的参加者额度，不能用旧主持席位或月活联系人数模型替代本次方案。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: a product webinar with later replay
sections.title_zh: 示例：含后续回放的产品研讨会
sections.en:
Create a session, registration form and email cadence; assign moderators and connect the intended CRM integration. Run the live event, inspect questions/polls and publish replay according to policy. Compare registration with actual attendance and downstream contact activity; a registration alone is not a delivered viewing. No event was run.

For credits, one person joining two different sessions uses two credits under the published unique-person-per-session rule. Multiple viewing modes of one session should be checked against actual metering before budgeting.
sections.zh:
创建场次、注册表及邮件节奏，分配主持人并连接所需 CRM；直播后检查问答/投票，按政策提供回放。应对照注册、实际参加及下游联系人活动，注册不等于已观看。本次未办活动。

按公开每独立人员每场次规则，同一个人参加两个不同场次使用两个额度。同场多种观看方式的计量需账户确认后再预算。

sections.title_en: Credits and time limits still apply to unlimited events
sections.title_zh: 活动不限仍有额度和时长限制
sections.en:
The read example offers 400 credits at €2.50 per attendee; this is a selected volume, not a universal marginal price. Pro lists four hours per session and unlimited events/recording/team members; Enterprise lists up to twelve hours and custom conditions. Live, replay and on-demand viewers count, team members do not. Confirm pool expiry, additional-credit costs, tax and concurrency with sales.

Several native CRM integrations are marked Enterprise-only. An integration name in the global navigation is not evidence that Pro includes it. A free trial does not establish an indefinite Free plan in the current offer.
sections.zh:
读取示例为 400 额度、每参加者 €2.50，这是选定用量，不是统一边际费率。Pro 每场四小时，活动/录制/团队成员不限；Enterprise 最多十二小时并定制。直播、回放和点播参加者计数，团队成员不计。应向销售确认到期、补额、税费及并发。

多个原生 CRM 集成标为 Enterprise 专属，全站导航出现名称不证明 Pro 包含。当前免费试用也不证明长期 Free 档。

sections.title_en: Separate event delivery from CRM delivery
sections.title_zh: 区分活动交付与 CRM 交付
sections.en:
Marketing/event teams can evaluate the full lifecycle; occasional private calls may not need registration and credit management. Reconcile attendee identity and event/session IDs before retrying a failed CRM handoff, and verify recording access before promising replay.

No stream, captions/translation, recording, API, billing, permissions, software licence, self-hosting or recovery was tested. Security/residency claims remain vendor statements pending contract and account verification.
sections.zh:
营销/活动团队可评估完整生命周期，偶尔私下通话未必需要注册及额度管理。CRM 交接重试前核对参加者身份及活动/场次标识，承诺回放前验证录制访问。

未测试直播、字幕/翻译、录制、API、计费、权限、软件许可、自托管或恢复。安全/驻留陈述仍需合同及账户确认。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Credit expiry/extra rates, exact replay counting, recording retention, integration tier, licence and recovery need account/contract checks.
research_gaps.zh: 额度到期/增量费率、回放计数、录制保留、集成档位、许可及恢复需账户/合同核对。
